{{DISPLAYTITLE:Timeline of events in ''Pokémon the Series: XY''}}
{{spoilers}}
In {{aniseries|XY}}, [[Ash Ketchum]] arrives in the [[Kalos]] [[region]] to pursue his dream of becoming a [[Pokémon Master]]. He meets {{an|Clemont}}, an inventor and the [[Lumiose City]] [[Gym Leader]]; his young sister {{an|Bonnie}}; and {{an|Serena}}, a childhood acquaintance of his who joins them on their {{pkmn|journey}}. Together, Ash and {{ashfr}} travel across Kalos as Ash aims to collect eight [[Badge|Gym Badges]] to qualify for the [[Kalos League]], while Serena, after much consideration what her goal should be, chooses to become a [[Pokémon Performer]] and compete in [[Pokémon Showcase]]s to become the {{DL|Pokémon Performer|Kalos Queen}}. During this journey, the group uncovers the mysteries of [[Mega Evolution]] and ends up coming face to face with the villainous [[Team Flare]].
